newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sets 9-month T-bill auction for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sets 9-month T-bill auction for Wed.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry on Wednesday will auction an unspecified tranche of nine-month T-bills, the first of such a maturity this year, the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Monday.
Juraj Macejka, head of the ministry's state final account, told Reuters yield in the auction was expected to reach around 8.5-9.0 percent.
"There will be more, perhaps four or five, of longer issues this year to help cover the expected 1996 budget deficit," he said.
Macejka declined to outline the expected volume of the issues, but said the budget deficit should be "lower than targetted".
The Slovak government in it's 1996 state budget plan aimed for a deficit of 27 billion crowns. As of the end of August, the state budget was in deficit by some 7.94 billion crowns.
